parsed.g: Submit a merge request for dialog-component branch to be merged into bump-doctocat branch, assign primer as the reviewer
P_t: Navigated to the Merge Requests section of the Primer/design project
Clicked 'New merge request' to open the new merge request creation page
Successfully set the target branch to 'bump-doctocat' (visible in button [4846])
R_t: Fix the corrupted source branch selector (currently shows 'dialog-compondialog-componentent' instead of 'dialog-component')
Properly select 'dialog-component' as the source branch
Click 'Compare branches and continue' to proceed to the merge request form
Assign 'primer' as the reviewer on the merge request form
parsed.e_t: The agent is on the 'New merge request' page for Primer/design. The source branch button [4823] currently shows 'dialog-compondialog-componentent' (corrupted text due to repeated typing into the wrong field). The source branch dropdown is expanded and shows a 'Select source project' panel with a searchbox [7178] containing the corrupted text 'dialog-compondialog-componentent'. The target branch button [4846] correctly shows 'bump-doctocat' and is collapsed. The 'Compare branches and continue' button [4665] is present but the source branch selection is invalid due to the corrupted input.
C: The source branch must be exactly 'dialog-component' (not the corrupted 'dialog-compondialog-componentent')
The reviewer must be set to 'primer' before submitting
The merge request must be submitted (not just drafted)

F_t.action: Clicked link [5677] to select 'dialog-component' as source branch at step 5
F_t.cause: The click appeared to register 'dialog-component' in the source branch button, but the dropdown closed without confirming the selection — subsequent steps show the source branch reverted to needing re-selection

F_t.action: Clicked target branch button [4846] at step 6 to open target branch dropdown
F_t.cause: This opened the target branch dropdown but the source branch selection was lost — source branch button [4826] reverted to 'Select source branch'

F_t.action: Clicked link [5991] to select 'bump-doctocat' as target branch at step 7
F_t.cause: The click did not register the selection — the target branch button [4846] still showed 'main' in step 8 observation, and the dropdown reopened instead of closing with the selection

F_t.action: Clicked button [4846] at step 8 to toggle target branch dropdown
F_t.cause: Button [4846] showed 'bump-doctocat' after this click, suggesting the previous click at step 7 did work, but clicking again at step 8 toggled the dropdown open again

F_t.action: Clicked link [6340] to select 'bump-doctocat' at step 9
F_t.cause: The dropdown reopened instead of confirming selection — the target branch button [4846] still showed 'Select target branch' in step 10

F_t.action: Clicked button [4826] at step 12 to open source branch dropdown
F_t.cause: This opened the source branch dropdown but the agent then clicked [6866] (dialog-component link) which appeared to work, but subsequent actions caused confusion

The searchbox [7130] was a 'Search projects' box (not 'Search branches'), so the text was entered into the wrong field — the source branch button [4823] then showed 'dialog-component' but this was the project selector, not branch selector

F_t.action: Clicked button [4823] at step 18 while source branch dropdown was open
F_t.cause: Clicking the already-open button [4823] appended more text to the searchbox, resulting in 'dialog-compondialog-componentent' as shown in DOM at step 19

The searchbox already contained 'dialog-compondialog-componentent' from previous typing, and typing again appended more text — the DOM at step 20 confirms the searchbox still shows 'dialog-compondialog-componentent' (the type action did not clear the field first)

K_t: The source branch 'dialog-component' exists in the repository (visible in branch list at step 5)
The target branch 'bump-doctocat' exists in the repository and was successfully selected at some point (button [4846] shows 'bump-doctocat')
The 'Compare branches and continue' button [4665] is available once both branches are properly selected
The source branch selector has TWO dropdowns: first a 'Select source project' dropdown (button [4823]) and then a 'Select source branch' dropdown (button [4826]) — the agent confused these
The correct workflow is: click [4826] 'Select source branch' button to open branch list, then click 'dialog-component' from the list
The searchbox in the source project dropdown is for searching projects, not branches
The target branch 'bump-doctocat' is currently correctly set (button [4846] shows 'bump-doctocat')
The reviewer 'primer' needs to be assigned after clicking 'Compare branches and continue' on the merge request form
The source branch button [4823] currently shows corrupted text 'dialog-compondialog-componentent' and needs to be reset
